# A multiline throw of an Error created elsewhere.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION raise_later() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS """const err = new Error('boom');
  throw err;
""";
SELECT raise_later()
?>

# A throw from a helper rather than directly from the UDF body.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION raise_nested() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS """function helper() {
  throw new Error('nested');
}
return helper();
""";
SELECT raise_nested()
?>

# The original throw crosses a finally block before escaping the UDF.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION raise_with_finally() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS """try {
  throw new Error('boom');
} finally {
  void 0;
}
""";
SELECT raise_with_finally()
?>

# JavaScript also permits throwing values that are not Error objects.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION raise_string() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS "throw 'boom';";
SELECT raise_string()
?>
